title: Finite intrinsic Verdier preservation with the sharp interval
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D, prime l different from its characteristic, a finite extension E of Q_l, and a separated finite-type scheme X over D.k. At index n (coefficient exponent n+1), let M be an intrinsic bounded constructible complex with Tor amplitude [a,b], and let dim X <= d. The actual ambient derived internal Hom from M into integralDualizingFiniteTerm is intrinsic bounded constructible, has Tor amplitude [-b-2d,-a], and has cohomological support in that same interval. This is a single finite-level result, with no integral completeness assumption.

proof.text: Use the constructible descent and interval reflection clauses of coefFiniteHomSiteDescent to choose an etale finite-Tor origin with the given interval.
The etale unit is finite-Tor constructible, hence so is its geometric dualizing complex. Apply verdier_preservation_strata to the etale origin and supplied dimension bound.

Apply the normalized site Hom comparison and finiteDualizingOrigin, composing with the exact-functor composition isomorphism, to identify the intrinsic dual with the comparison image of the etale dual. Transport constructibility and Tor amplitude through this isomorphism.

Use the finite-coefficient flat-model theorem to choose a complex with terms zero outside the desired interval. Its homology vanishes there, and the homology localization comparison transfers this vanishing to the derived dual.

theorem finiteIntrinsicVerdier_bounds (n : ℕ)
    (M : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionTarget.{u, u} l E X n))
    (hM : intrinsicFiniteTorsionConstructible l E (n + 1) (by omega) X M)
    (d : ℕ) (hd : topologicalKrullDim X ≤ (d : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (a b : ℤ) (hTor : HasProEtaleTorAmplitude X
      (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1)) M a b) :
    let N := (finiteDual l E X n (integralDualizingFiniteTerm l E D X n)).obj (op M)
    intrinsicFiniteTorsionConstructible l E (n + 1) (by omega) X N ∧
      HasProEtaleTorAmplitude X (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1))
        N (-b - 2 * (d : ℤ)) (-a) ∧
      proEtaleCohomologicalSupport N ⊆ Set.Icc (-b - 2 * (d : ℤ)) (-a)
